notes.title: RUBATO Demo Version 30 & 31 - Changelog
notes.content:
[p]Yay! I updated the demo for the thirtieth time, just in time for SAGE 2025! This version of the demo is now a close representation of the final game. This will be similar to what Headcannon will put out on consoles in the near future. [/p][h1]Version 30 Changelog:[/h1][list][*][p]New art everywhere. New portraits, new main menu, new fonts, new lots of things. It's been a year since the last demo update, so a lot has changed![/p][/*][*][p]A handful of new costumes, though there will be more once the game is finally released![/p][/*][*][p]Significant optimisations - the game will run faster on all platforms thanks to the work put in to getting the game running on Switch 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Significant QoL since the last demo version - scrollable menu, extendable camera, you name it![/p][/*][*][p]Significant bug fixes - apparently I forgot to make it so control bindings save. Nice one me.[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of other stuff I forgot about.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Version 31 Changelog:[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed a pesky bug regarding textbox layering issues…
[/p][/*][/list][p]The game is pretty much done now. Hopefully in a few months, a release date can be announced! See you very soon![/p]

notes.title: RUBATO Demo Version 22
notes.content:
Another demo update, this time to coincide with the game's presence at this years SXSW Sydney Game's Festival and The Leftfield Collection @ EGX x MCM. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43313200/8f2ee3915ea9998981744cbfe56e284299d4b495.png[/img]

[h1]Features include:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Vending machines, which you can use to get bonus health! But they cost 500 balls!? In this economy!?
[*] UI improvements, including the cursor changing colour when equipping different items. 
[*] Several million bugfixes, including physics stability improvements.
[*] A couple of really exceedingly rare random events.
[*] Some additional cutscenes (including one that reminds you to see Tokki).
[*] Changed the interact key on controller to be it's own button, so you don't accidentally open doors and talk to NPCs whilst jumping.
[*] A little surprise for when you start a new save file.
[*] A lot of small stuff that I don't really have noted down that was done on a whim... Spot the difference, because I suck at keeping track of changes sometimes!
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Version 16 (and 15!) - NOW RELEASED!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43313200/7097be56469f7df6c50639ab0d82bbee68d32b7f.png[/img]

Demo version 15 is now out, in time for Steam Next Fest! This demo has a completely new intro sequence, alongside other bits of new content! Hurray!

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] A new, extended intro sequence with lots of new art and a new tutorial!
[*] A new costume, "Blue-Handed Rubato". WE WERE HACKED!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
[*] Tons of level design alterations to make the flow of the beginning moments of the game a little easier.
[*] Some new secrets.
[*] Props are now destructible with the rocket launcher. You can finally explode toilets! Hurray!
[*] Game is updated to match how the game currently is in-development with all the quiet fixes that come along with that. Screenshake toggling, visual enhancements, bugfixes etc. You get the idea.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43313200/7912d25ea7da8036b28e8303f690e1e99c943b07.gif[/img]

[h1][b]UPDATE:[/b] DEMO VERSION 16 RELEASED[/h1]

Very quick additional update that outside of some very small bugfixes, fixes some very minor design consistency issues!

notes.title: RUBATO Demo Update @ Steam Next Fest June 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43313200/7097be56469f7df6c50639ab0d82bbee68d32b7f.png[/img]

RUBATO arrives to Steam Next Fest, this June! The event will run from [b]June 10th - June 17th[/b], featuring a plethora of new and upcoming games. Gameplay footage will be streamed to the store page, allowing those who haven't seen the game yet to get a quick fix on what it's all about. 

Additionally, a new, heavily revised version of the demo will be released alongside the event, featuring a heavily reworked intro sequence and lots of changes and fixes! Expect this demo update to release May 27th!

notes.title: Demo Version 14
notes.content: Fixed some issues regarding the objective system. Introduced very minor quality-of-life improvements, such as introducing more checkpoints in subareas and making things like the tutorial text have clearer wording.

notes.title: RUBATO - Demo Update (Version 12)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43313200/0e2141c9c1a2ca4099c94f4ab5cfe9876ee5784a.png[/img]
Wow! Two years since the RUBATO Demo has launched! I've gone​ ahead and updated the game to match how the game is currently in-development. Likely the last update I'll do before the game releases - now I've just got to get the damn game finished!

The most notable changes are:
[list]
[*]     Improved performance. Massive changes have been done under the hood to improve the game. If you found earlier versions of the demo to struggle on your computer, then this should fare a lot better!
[*]     Improved controller support and UI!
[*]     New layouts and some new Bakery content. Some new secrets too!
[*]     Improved graphics, sounds and music. Don't know how much has changed since I last updated the game, but I imagine it's alot
[*]     A lot of insignificant changes! You probably won't notice all of them!
[/list]

I'm still a little while away from announcing any sort of release date away, but hopefully this gives a little preview into some of the under-the-hood improvements I'm making to the game!
